start: Add the annual meeting from the statutes
lead: Upload your statutes and Simon Says makes the annual meeting's agenda.
hint: Google Doc or PDF, at most 10 MB. Simon Says only stores the items, never the statutes.
edit: You see and can change the items before they're saved.
pickerFailed: The Google picker couldn't be opened. Try again.
readFailed: Simon Says couldn't read the statutes. Try again.
offline: We couldn't reach the server. Check the network and try again.
saveFailed: The annual meeting couldn't be saved. Try again.
reading: Simon Says is reading the statutes … it takes about half a minute.
empty: The statutes list no agenda for the annual meeting. The annual meeting follows the standard agenda.
saved: Saved: the annual meeting's {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}.
standard: The annual meeting follows the standard agenda.
follows: The annual meeting follows your statutes.
pick: Choose the statutes in Google Drive
pickerOff: The Google picker isn't set up yet, so the statutes can be read later.
